rationale: The shared ListMetadata cursor envelope declares before/after as optional, but every WorkOS list response carries both cursor pointers on the wire (null at the list boundaries, never absent) - the design-approved exemplar models them as required nullable strings, and cursor pagination demands a required next-cursor leaf. Atomic component fact; affects every operation whose envelope references ListMetadata.

provenance.observed: List responses always include list_metadata.before and list_metadata.after, null when there is no page in that direction.
provenance.specd: The shared ListMetadata component marks both cursor pointers required (still nullable), matching the wire.
